enroll.title: Add your Canvas token

steps.one: In Canvas, open Account → Settings → + New Access Token.
steps.two: Purpose: <c>Claude MCP</c>. Set an expiry date.
steps.three: Copy the token and paste it below.

enroll.warning: Never paste the token into Claude.
enroll.helper: {{min}} to {{max}} characters. It is checked against Canvas, stored encrypted and never shown again.
enroll.expiresHelper: The date you set in Canvas. It is only used to remind you before the token stops working.

identityChange.title: Replace with a different Canvas user?
identityChange.body: This token belongs to {{next}}, but the token currently enrolled belongs to {{enrolled}}. If you continue, Claude reads Canvas as {{next}} from now on.

delete.confirmBody: Claude will not be able to read Canvas as you until you add a new token.

canvas_token_rejected.title: Canvas rejected your token
canvas_token_rejected.body: Claude's Canvas tools stay disabled until you replace it. If Canvas accepts the token again, re-check it.

decrypt_failed.title: The stored token could not be read
decrypt_failed.body: Claude's Canvas tools stay disabled until you add a new token.

revoked_by_admin.title: An administrator turned your token off
revoked_by_admin.body: Claude's Canvas tools stay disabled until you add a new token.

expiry.soonBody: You noted that it expires on {{date}}. Create a new token in Canvas and replace this one before then.
expiry.passedTitle: The expiry date you noted has passed
expiry.passedBody: You noted that it expires on {{date}}. Canvas may reject it now, so replace it with a new token.

writeTools.title: Write tools
writeTools.intro: Claude can only read Canvas unless you turn on specific tools that change things as you. Each tool is off by default.
writeTools.serverDisabled: This server does not offer any write tools, so none of these can be turned on.
writeTools.layersNote: A tool runs only when all three agree. Previews, confirmations, course policy and your client's approval prompts still apply to every change.
writeTools.freshNote: Turning a tool on needs a sign-in from the last 10 minutes; turning one off never does. Your AI app may remember the tool list, so start a new chat after a change.
